title: Remote foundations M2: central mailbox routing, participant directory and protocol conformance (list/read/ACK always served by the central host)
outcome: Remote foundations M2: central mailbox routing, participant directory and protocol conformance (list/read/ACK always served by the central host)
acceptance: Every local and remote participant mailbox operation (get-or-create, send, list, read page, read message, receipt-only acknowledge) is served by the central host; a satellite's bridge and CLI relay to it over L1 and hold no mailbox state (tests).
Simultaneous A->B and B->A first sends yield exactly one mailbox and one membership record at the central host (test).

With the central host unreachable, remote list/read/ACK fail visibly with a retryable unavailable error; there is no cache-served read, alternate ownership or local mailbox-authority write; sender intents stay separately visible (tests).
Revocation and session recreation cannot inherit access; protocol version, schema and size negotiation are explicit and existing limits (body 256 KiB etc.) apply unchanged (tests).
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
